title: The Very Pink
subtitle: Five carats of Fancy Very Pink, its colour even through the whole crystal.

stone.origin: Lab-grown, uniform colour distribution. 13.54 x 9.14 x 5.78 mm. Provenance certificate available.

metal: 18K white gold, 18K yellow gold, 18K rose gold, or platinum
description: An oval of Fancy Very Pink, its colour carried evenly through the entire crystal rather than pooling in the centre — so the stone reads as one continuous blush from edge to edge, whichever way it turns. The oval shape stretches that colour along a longer axis, giving it room to open across the finger. The setting stays deliberately spare, offered in white, yellow, or rose gold or platinum, each metal shifting how the pink reads. The stone is the entire event; the ring only holds it.
